# B3 corpus sources (FMA fma_full)

Licence filter: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, public domain. Any NC or ND string, Free Music Philosophy, Art Libre,
Sampling Plus, CopyrightPlus, EFF Open Audio, missing and other unclear strings are out.
FMA metadata has no per-track page URL, only the licence string; URL below is the member of `https://os.unil.cloud.switch.ch/fma/fma_full.zip`.
